results.title: Giving Spokane something to cheer: Ferris grad Lucas Jumalon remains on top moving to second day of World Series of Poker Main Event; two players eliminated
results.description: Aug. 4—LAS VEGAS − Dressed in a black T-shirt depicting Tony Montana from "Scarface," Lucas Jumalon entered the final table of the World Series of Poker main event with guns blazing. After being called to find his seat, the 22-year-old Ferris High School graduate jogged past Bruce Buffer, the voice of the octagon, with finger guns aimed at the crowd from Spokane. results.title: Brewers send pitcher Brandon Sproat to Triple-A after acquiring Dustin May
results.description: With the Milwaukee Brewers’ trade-deadline acquisition of veteran starter Dustin May, rookie right-hander Brandon Sproat became the odd man out of the rotation.
